title: Frosty Quest
description: Frosty Quest is a fun and exciting match-3 puzzle game set in a magical winter wonderland. In this icy adventure, players must match and align adorable winter-themed characters to score points and clear the board. As the levels progress, the difficulty increases, making every new stage a thrilling challenge. With charming graphics, festive music, and easy-to-learn mechanics, Frosty Quest offers an entertaining and addictive experience for players of all ages.
